package loadtest

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	generated "GENRE_MODULE/loadtest/protocol"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/msgid"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/action"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/protocol"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/runner"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/scenario"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/session"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/transport"
)

// Coop 完成一对客户端的整局；每个 Runner 实例只使用这一对已分配房间的身份。
// 规模压测应为每对机器人分配不同房间和票据，不能复用本次领奖后的存档刷吞吐。
func Coop(cfg runner.Config, roomID int64, auth [2]robot.AuthProvider) *runner.Runner {
	protocols := protocol.NewRegistry(nil)
	generated.RegisterDefaults(protocols)
	scenarios := scenario.NewRegistry()
	scenarios.MustRegister(scenario.New("coop-full", scenario.NodeFunc(func(ctx context.Context, first *robot.Context) error {
		peerConfig := first.Config
		peerConfig.Auth = auth[1]
		peer := robot.NewContext(peerConfig)
		peer.RunAction = first.RunAction
		defer peer.Close()
		clients := [2]*robot.Context{first, peer}
		var initial [2]int64
		for i, client := range clients {
			if err := client.Do(ctx, action.NameConnect, nil); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			view, err := CoopView(ctx, client, roomID)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if view.Stage != 0 || view.Cleared || view.Claimed || view.Revision != 0 {
				return fmt.Errorf("room is not fresh")
			}
			initial[i] = view.Coins
		}
		for stage := range 3 {
			for seat, client := range clients {
				view, err := CoopView(ctx, client, roomID)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				request := &pb.ScenarioCommandRequest{RoomID: roomID, Seq: view.NextSeq, Revision: view.Revision, Kind: "vote", Choice: int32((stage + seat) % 2)}
				if _, err = CoopCommand(ctx, client, request); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}
		for seat, client := range clients {
			view, err := CoopView(ctx, client, roomID)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if !view.Cleared || view.Stage != 3 || view.Claimed {
				return fmt.Errorf("unexpected stage before claim: %+v", view)
			}
			request := &pb.ScenarioCommandRequest{RoomID: roomID, Seq: view.NextSeq, Revision: view.Revision, Kind: "claim"}
			for range 2 {
				response, err := CoopCommand(ctx, client, request)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if response.Reward != 10 {
					return fmt.Errorf("wrong reward: %d", response.Reward)
				}
			}
			if err = client.Do(ctx, action.NameConnect, nil); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if _, err = CoopCommand(ctx, client, request); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			view, err = CoopView(ctx, client, roomID)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if !view.Claimed || view.Coins != initial[seat]+10 {
				return fmt.Errorf("client reward view mismatch: %+v", view)
			}
			// 新序号再次领奖必须拒绝；回执重试成功与资产重复领取是两种不同语义。
			request.Seq = view.NextSeq
			request.Revision = view.Revision
			if _, err = CoopCommand(ctx, client, request); !errors.Is(err, session.ErrRejected) {
				return fmt.Errorf("duplicate claim: %w", err)
			}
		}
		for seat, client := range clients {
			view, err := CoopView(ctx, client, roomID)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if view.Revision != 8 || !view.Cleared || !view.Claimed || view.Coins != initial[seat]+10 {
				return fmt.Errorf("final client view mismatch: %+v", view)
			}
		}
		return nil
	})))
	cfg.Count = 1
	cfg.Executor = runner.ExecutorPool
	cfg.Scenario = "coop-full"
	cfg.Transport.Type = transport.PlayerTCPType
	return runner.New(cfg, runner.WithProtocolRegistry(protocols), runner.WithScenarioRegistry(scenarios), runner.WithAuthProvider(auth[0]))
}
func CoopView(ctx context.Context, client *robot.Context, roomID int64) (*pb.CoopViewResponse, error) {
	msg, err := client.Session().CallChecked(ctx, msgid.MsgCoopView, msgid.MsgCoopView, &pb.CoopViewRequest{RoomID: roomID}, func(m *session.Message) error {
		response, ok := m.Value.(*pb.CoopViewResponse)
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid view response")
		}
		if response.Code != 0 {
			return session.ErrRejected
		}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return msg.Value.(*pb.CoopViewResponse), nil
}
func CoopCommand(ctx context.Context, client *robot.Context, request *pb.ScenarioCommandRequest) (*pb.ScenarioCommandResponse, error) {
	msg, err := client.Session().CallChecked(ctx, msgid.MsgScenarioCommand, msgid.MsgScenarioCommand, request, func(m *session.Message) error {
		response, ok := m.Value.(*pb.ScenarioCommandResponse)
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid command response")
		}
		if response.Code != 0 {
			return session.ErrRejected
		}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return msg.Value.(*pb.ScenarioCommandResponse), nil
}
